source_name: NBRSM — Registers (Payment services & payment systems) / Регистри (ПУПС)
why_relevant: Hub page grouping all NBRSM-maintained registers under the Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems (payment institutions, e-money institutions, payment system operators, exempt providers). Enumerates every regulated non-bank payment actor in MK and is the natural snowball root for actor mapping.

source_name: NBRSM — Register of Electronic Money Institutions / Регистар на институции за електронски пари
why_relevant: Authoritative list of licensed e-money institutions — the exact actor set for fintech/payments market mapping in MK. New entrants and revocations appear here first.

source_name: NBRSM — Register of payment system operators (EN)
why_relevant: Lists licensed payment system operators (e.g. KIBS and other clearing/settlement operators) — small but strategically decisive actor set for payments infrastructure intelligence.

source_name: NBRSM — Banking System of the Republic of North Macedonia (list of licensed banks & savings houses)
why_relevant: Canonical downloadable list of banks and savings houses holding an NBRSM licence — the master actor roster for the MK banking sector (13 commercial banks + development bank + savings houses).

source_name: NBRSM — Savings houses / Штедилници
why_relevant: Separate register/section for savings houses (штедилници), a distinct MK institution class often missed by English-only scouting; relevant to microlending and deposit-taking coverage.

source_name: NBRSM — Banks, savings houses and other financial institutions (data section)
why_relevant: Publishes per-institution and aggregate data on banks, savings houses and other financial institutions — the bridge between the register (who exists) and the financials (how big / how healthy).

source_name: NBRSM — Data and indicators for the banking system of RNM
why_relevant: Core supervisory dataset: banking-system indicators (capital adequacy, NPLs, profitability, assets), typically quarterly, per-bank and aggregate. Highest-value recurring quantitative feed in the cell.

source_name: NBRSM — Data publication calendar for the banking system
why_relevant: Tells a collector exactly WHEN each banking-system dataset drops — turns ad-hoc scraping into a scheduled pipeline and flags missed/late releases.

source_name: NBRSM — Decision on publication of reports and data by banks (Одлука за објавување извештаи и податоци од страна на банката)
why_relevant: The legal instrument that COMPELS each bank to publish disclosure reports (MK Pillar-3 analogue), Official Gazette 36/23, applied from 1 Jan 2025. Defines what every bank must publish, in what format and on what deadline — i.e. it specifies the shape of the entire per-bank disclosure corpus a scout can then collect from bank websites.

source_name: NBRSM — Banking supervision and regulation section
why_relevant: Top-level supervision hub: regulation (одлуки, упатства), supervisory methodology, licensing, and links to supervisory publications. Root node for snowballing all prudential-disclosure sub-sources.

source_name: NBRSM — Annual Reports (Годишни извештаи)
why_relevant: The central bank's own annual report — includes banking-system developments, payment-system operations and oversight, and institutional financials. Anchor annual document for the cell; EN editions published as PDFs.

source_name: NBRSM — Financial Stability Reports (Извештаи за финансиската стабилност)
why_relevant: Annual/periodic financial stability report covering banking-system risks, credit quality, liquidity, and increasingly digital-payments and operational/cyber risk chapters. Confirmed EN mirror exists.

source_name: NBRSM — Payment systems and payment services section
why_relevant: Umbrella section for payment-system oversight: MIPS, KIBS, national payments council, licensing, registers, statistics. Primary snowball root for the payments half of the cell.

source_name: NBRSM — MIPS (Macedonian Interbank Payment System) pages
why_relevant: RTGS operated by the central bank since July 2001; page documents participants, rules and operating data. Core infrastructure fact base for payments market intelligence; EN mirror confirmed.

source_name: NBRSM — KIBS oversight page (Клириншки интербанкарски системи)
why_relevant: Documents KIBS, the privately operated multilateral net retail clearing system subject to NBRSM oversight, its participants (banks, Treasury, Health Insurance Fund) and settlement windows. Identifies a key non-central-bank payments actor to scout separately.

source_name: NBRSM — Payment statistics (Платежна статистика)
why_relevant: Time series on payment cards, POS terminals, ATMs, credit transfers and transaction volumes/values, with archives reported from January 2005 onward. This is the single most quantitatively useful payments dataset in MK for terminal/acceptance market sizing.

source_name: NBRSM — Credit Registry (Кредитен регистар)
why_relevant: Central bank credit registry: documentation and aggregate outputs on credit exposures of banks/savings houses. Micro-data is restricted, but the page describes scope, reporting obligations and any published aggregates — useful for lending-market structure.

source_name: NBRSM — Exchange offices register (Менувачници)
why_relevant: Register/authorisation section for licensed FX exchange offices — a large, fragmented cash-handling actor population relevant to cash-cycle and retail-FX intelligence, invisible to English-only searching.

source_name: NBRSM — Licensing under the Payment Services Law (Издавање дозволи)
why_relevant: Describes licence requirements and the application process for payment institutions and e-money institutions (contact licenciranjepups@nbrm.mk). Signals entry barriers and, over time, the pipeline of new fintech entrants.

source_name: NBRSM — Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems (Закон за платежни услуги и платни системи)
why_relevant: The PSD2-aligned primary law creating the payment-institution and e-money-institution categories and the register obligations. Defines the entire regulated-actor taxonomy this cell maps.

source_name: NBRSM — Public relations / press releases (Односи со јавност, Соопштенија)
why_relevant: Press-release stream announcing licence grants/revocations, new regulation, quarterly macro reports, financial stability committee outputs. Highest-frequency early-warning feed in the cell; individual releases live at ns-newsarticle-soopstenie-<date>.nspx with '-en' variants.

source_name: NBRSM — National Council for Payment Systems (Национален совет за платните системи)
why_relevant: Multi-stakeholder body (central bank, banks, ministries, infrastructure operators) steering national payments strategy; membership and minutes reveal which institutions shape payments modernisation (instant payments, standards) before it becomes public policy.

source_name: NBRSM — List of bank leading (routing) numbers
why_relevant: Canonical bank identifier list (водечки броеви) usable as the join key across NBRSM datasets, MIPS/KIBS participation and bank-published statements. Small but high-leverage for data engineering.

source_name: NBRSM — List of information of public character (Листа на информации)
why_relevant: Freedom-of-information catalogue: enumerates what NBRSM holds and will release on request. A legal fallback route for datasets not published proactively, and an inventory of hidden holdings.

source_name: NBRSM — Report on financial position of the National Bank (Извештај за финансиска состојба)
why_relevant: Periodic financial statements of the central bank itself — audited accounts, balance sheet, income. Relevant for institutional/procurement-capacity intelligence rather than commercial-bank analysis.

source_name: uslugi.gov.mk — NBRSM institution profile (national services catalogue)
why_relevant: Government service catalogue listing NBRSM's administrative services (licences, registrations, consents) as structured records. Useful as an independent, non-bot-defended mirror of what NBRSM formally issues, and as a cross-check when nbrm.mk is unreachable.

source_name: SEI-Net — Електронски систем за информирање на котираните друштва (MSE issuer disclosure portal)
why_relevant: Statutory portal where every MSE-listed issuer, including all listed banks, files price-sensitive information: earnings releases, shareholder-assembly calls, significant-shareholder changes, insider transactions. Highest-density single stream for the cell.
